```{r}
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(ggsflabel)
library(raster)
library(exactextractr)

t_crs<-"+proj=aea +lat_1=-9 +lat_2=-26 +lat_0=-17 +lon_0=180 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"

```
# Population

```{r}
pop_ras_proj<-raster(here("projected_data/Population/FJI_Pop_Grid_proj.tif"))

pop_ras_proj<-setMinMax(pop_ras_proj)
```


# Tikina/watershed map

```{r}
fiji_basins<-st_read(here("projected_data/Basins/Fiji_Basins12_albers.shp")) %>% 
  filter(!MAIN_BAS %in% c(5120082250))

fiji_basins<-fiji_basins %>% 
  dplyr::select(MAIN_BAS) %>% 
  mutate(basin_area_m2 = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>% 
  group_by(MAIN_BAS) %>% 
  summarise(basin_area_m2 = sum(basin_area_m2, na.rm = T))
```


```{r}
tik<-st_read(here("projected_data/Tikina/Fiji_tikina.shp")) %>% 
  st_transform(., crs = t_crs) %>% 
  mutate(area = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>% 
  group_by(TIKINA, ADM1_NAME) %>%
  summarise(area = sum(area, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(Area = case_when(TIKINA == "Suva" ~ "Suva",
                          TIKINA == "Nadi" ~ "Nadi",
                          ADM1_NAME == "Northern  Division" ~ "Northern Division",
                          TIKINA == "Baravi" ~ "Coral Coast",
                          TIKINA == "Nasigatoka" ~ "Coral Coast",
                          TIKINA == "Cuvu" ~ "Coral Coast",
                          TIKINA == "Malomalo" ~ "Coral Coast",
                          TIKINA == "Vuda" ~ "Lautoka",
                          TIKINA == "Malolo" ~ "Mamanuca"),
         Area = ifelse(is.na(Area) == T, "Others", as.character(Area)))

#crop_tik<-st_crop(tik, fiji_basins) %>% 
  
crop_tik<-tik %>% 
  mutate(Island = ifelse(ADM1_NAME %in% c("Central Division", "Western Division"), "Viti Levu",
                                          ifelse(ADM1_NAME == "Northern  Division", "Vanua Levu", NA)))

labels<-c("Nadi", "Ba", "Vuda", "Rewa", "Suva")

# Also label Laucala Bay and Nadi Bay, Rewa River
# Viti Levu and Vanua Levu

crop_tik2<-crop_tik %>% 
  filter(ADM1_NAME != "Eastern Division") %>% 
  group_by(TIKINA, Island) %>% 
  summarise(diss = sum(area, na.rm = T)) %>% 
  mutate(label = ifelse(TIKINA %in% labels, TIKINA, NA)) 
  
```

```{r}
stp_shp<-st_read(here("raw_data/Sewage_plants/Fiji Waste Water Catchment.shp"))
```

WWTP

```{r}
wwtp<-st_read("/home/kuempel/Waste_water_data/Fiji/Sewage_plants/Fiji Wastewater Treatment plants.kml")

wwtp2<-wwtp %>% 
  mutate(long = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2]) %>% 
  st_transform(.,t_crs) %>% 
  filter(!str_detect(Name, 'Outfall'),
         str_detect(Name, "Plant"),
         !str_detect(Name, "ACS"),
         !str_detect(Name, "Naboro"),
         !str_detect(Name, "Wailada")) %>% 
  mutate(wwtp_label = str_remove(Name, " Sewage Treatment Plant"),
         wwtp_label = str_remove(wwtp_label, " Sewage Plant"),
         wwtp_label = ifelse(wwtp_label == "PWD", "Kinoya", 
                             ifelse(wwtp_label == "Lautoka Natabua", "Lautoka",
                                    ifelse(wwtp_label == "Labasa Namara", "Namara",
                                           ifelse(wwtp_label == "Nausori Nadali", "Nadali", 
                                                  ifelse(wwtp_label == "Pacific Harbor", "Deuba", wwtp_label))))))
```
# Population per basin

```{r}
pop_basin<-extract(pop_ras_proj, fiji_basins, fun = sum, na.rm = TRUE)

pop_basin2<-cbind(fiji_basins, pop_basin)
```



# Plot
```{r}
tmap_pop<-tm_shape(pop_basin2) +
    tm_polygons(col = "pop_basin",
                style = "cont",
                title = "Population",
                palette = "-viridis") +
  tm_scale_bar() +
  tm_shape(crop_tik2) +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_text("label",
          auto.placement = 0.1,
          size = 1,
          just = "top",
          bg.color = "white",
          bg.alpha = 0.7) #+
 # tm_shape(wwtp2) +
```
